about_short_description.short_description: PopSQL is a modern, collaborative SQL editor for teams.

product.name: PopSQL Collaborative SQL Editor
product.description: A SQL editor designed for team collaboration, enabling centralized query management, real-time editing, and interactive data visualization.

product.name: PopSQL Database Connections and Connectivity
product.description: A system to securely connect PopSQL to various databases using multiple connection methods including direct, cloud, SSH tunnels, and bridge connectors.

product.name: PopSQL Real-Time Collaboration Features
product.description: Features that allow multiple users to collaborate on SQL queries simultaneously with commenting, version control, and shared connections.

product.name: PopSQL Data Visualization and Dashboarding
product.description: Tools within PopSQL to create charts, lightweight dashboards, and interactive reports directly from SQL query results.

product.name: PopSQL SQL Notebooks
product.description: A feature that enables users to combine multiple SQL queries, charts, and Markdown text to create data stories and reports.

product.name: PopSQL API and Git Integration
product.description: APIs for query management and scheduling, plus integration with Git for version control and code review.
